summary: This figure lays out Larch's three security goals using a small icon vocabulary of a relying party ('amazon'), a Client, and a Log server, repeated with color changes across three side-by-side panels. Goal 1 shows log enforcement against a malicious client: a green check marks the RP as protected and a lock icon secures the 'amazon' identifier. Goal 2 shows privacy and security against a malicious log: the log is shown querying which RP a client used, and separately an RP is shown disconnected (red X) from a compromised (red) log. Goal 3 shows privacy against a malicious relying party: two red RP icons are marked with a '?' to indicate they cannot tell whether they are colluding on the same client. Dotted vertical lines separate the three goal panels, and double-headed arrows show bidirectional interactions between icons.
